description: This is a Perl module source file implementing the Git::SVN::Fetcher package, which is a subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor used in the context of 'git svn fetch' operations. The file defines a class with methods for handling version control delta callbacks, managing files, directories, properties, and placeholders for fetching changes from SVN into Git. It also contains module documentation describing usage and purpose.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Fetcher
classes.description: A subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor, implementing callbacks to handle SVN tree delta events, store changes, handle directory and file properties, and manage placeholders during 'git svn fetch' operations.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor method initializing a new Fetcher object, loading configuration options, setting up internal state, and preparing for delta callbacks.

methods.name: _mark_empty_symlinks
methods.description: Static method to identify empty symlinks in a specific SVN revision, used to workaround broken sy link detection.

methods.name: in_dot_git
methods.description: Checks if a given path is inside a '.git' directory.

methods.name: is_path_ignored
methods.description: Determines whether a given path should be ignored based on ignore/include regex patterns and special directory checks.

methods.name: set_path_strip
methods.description: Sets a path prefix to be stripped from paths handled by this fetcher.

methods.name: open_root
methods.description: Returns a new root directory object for delta processing.

methods.name: open_directory
methods.description: Returns a directory object representing a directory at a given path.

methods.name: git_path
methods.description: Converts a given SVN path to a corresponding Git path, applying character encoding and path strip if configured.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Handles removal of files or directories at a given path, including recursive deletion for directories, and notes deletions.

methods.name: open_file
methods.description: Handles opening a file at a path, retrieves its mode and blob hash from SVN, and returns a file delta object.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Marks a file to be added with mode '100644' and returns a delta object.

methods.name: add_directory
methods.description: Marks a directory as added, manages placeholder files, and returns a directory object.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Records a change to directory properties.

methods.name: absent_directory
methods.description: Records a directory as absent/not retrievable due to permissions.

methods.name: absent_file
methods.description: Records a file as absent/not retrievable due to permissions.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Records a change in file properties such as 'svn:executable' and 'svn:special'.

methods.name: apply_textdelta
methods.description: Prepares for applying a text delta by acquiring temporary files and sets up the delta application process.

methods.name: close_file
methods.description: Finalizes a file change, verifies checksum, handles symlink conversions, computes object hash, and records the update.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the delta edit, cleaning up state.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the delta processing, including managing empty directories and placeholders, and cleans up state.

methods.name: find_empty_directories
methods.description: Identifies directories that are empty after deletions.

methods.name: add_placeholder_file
methods.description: Creates a placeholder file in an empty directory to prevent its deletion.

methods.name: stash_placeholder_list
methods.description: Stores the list of added placeholders into SVN config.
